ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 85% of pixels are low-intensity black/dark-grey, with approximately 15% high-intensity white/light-grey clustered in distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous mottled white/grey region on the distal third of the left lobe; smaller linear white patterning and mottling on the distal tip of the right lobe; central and proximal fluke surfaces consist of solid low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 72 degrees; high-depth bounding box relative to width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile with moderate frequency; highest pixel-amplitude variations found on the distal outer edges; trailing edge near the median notch transitions to a smoother, lower-amplitude topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary sweep trajectory exhibits a consistent convex curve from the median notch vertex to the outer lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast, raised white pixel groups localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed across the dark ventral surface; notably three parallel diagonal marks on the lower left lobe and several shorter vertical/diagonal marks on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake-mark abrasions across both lobes and heavy calcified colonization (barnacle clusters) at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique, high-contrast swirl-like pigmentation pattern located on the interior distal portion of the left lobe.
